exposure: Attitudes and beliefs related to CAM and maternity care
outcome: Use of pharmacological pain management techniques
Use of non-pharmacological pain management techniques
cohort: 1835 women aged 31-35 years who identified as being pregnant or recently given birth
finding: Previous caesarean section was the only determinant identified for use of all types of pain management techniques during labor.
mod_finding: A previous cesarean section is a significant determinant in a woman's choice to use any type of pain management during labor.
